kit.title: Quiet solid
kit.summary: Accent-filled buttons with small 4px corners and no border; the secondary is a plain text link. Calm, like a magazine page.

kit.title: Glass edge
kit.summary: Accent-filled buttons with 12px corners and a hairline border; the secondary is a bordered ghost. Label and fill swap on hover.

kit.title: Warm pill, soft shadow
kit.summary: Pill-shaped accent buttons with no border, resting on a soft warm shadow; the secondary is a plain text link. Friendly.

kit.title: Hairline dashed
kit.summary: Accent-filled buttons with 2px corners; the secondary is a 1px dashed outline, like a ruled grid. Precise, no softness.

kit.title: Chunky pill, offset shadow
kit.summary: Big pill-shaped accent buttons in a 2px text-colour outline on a hard offset shadow; label and fill swap on hover. Cheerful.

kit.title: Steady solid
kit.summary: Accent-filled buttons with consistent 6px corners and no border; the secondary is a plain text link. Restrained and credible.

kit.title: Soft rounded
kit.summary: Accent-filled buttons with 12px corners and a hairline border; the secondary is a quiet bordered button. Polished.

kit.title: Heavy block
kit.summary: Heavy accent buttons with 8px corners; the secondary is a 3px outline in the text colour. Label and fill swap on hover.

kit.title: Raw frame
kit.summary: Square accent buttons in a 4px text-colour frame with capital letters; label and fill swap on hover. Flat and blunt.

kit.title: Gilt hairline
kit.summary: Accent-filled buttons with 2px corners, a hairline border and spaced capital letters. Quiet and unhurried.
